author: GoPro
description:
Put this one on your bucket list ✈️ @ChrisFinck, @ellasends, @miahnielson, @TristanKuhn and @noahlipsitz took to the skies in an 80-year-old WWII-era Boeing Stearman biplane for an unforgettable sunset aerobatic flight over the stunning landscapes of West Virginia. Originally designed as a primary trainer for pilots during World War II, this legendary aircraft once prepared aviators for battle and now delivers pure adrenaline above New River Gorge and Summersville Lake. What started as a scenic ride quickly turned into nonstop flips, rolls, dives, and high-speed maneuvers that pushed us to 5Gs. Captured entirely on GoPro MAX2, this flight is a wild mix of history, breathtaking views, and full-throttle stunts.
